newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - North Korean advisers inspect Taiwan's nuclear waste dump on Lanyu island, Pyongyang promises shipping process will be safe.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taipei district prosecutor Hsu Liang-chien sentenced to 20 years in prison for corruption in video game scandal.
Police arrest two army deserters suspected of attacking two police officers, stealing their guns in Taipei county.
LIBERTY TIMES - Illegal stock analyst Tan Ching-lien detained as Taiwan intensifies crackdown on stock speculation.
Five executives of Asia Trust questioned for alleged influence-peddling.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Ministry of Transportation and Communications to set up telecommunications liberalisation committee.
U.S. dollar's strength overseas faces challenge.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Prosecutors question illegal stock analyst Tan Ching-lien in stock speculation crackdown.
President Enterprises to move Hong Kong-based holding company to Shanghai.
